name: Temur Battle Rage — "That creature also gains trample" is the target only
notes: Memory: project_audit_list_mismatch_round_seven_2026-10-11. "Ferocious — That creature also gains trample … if you control a creature with power 4 or greater" read "That creature also" as a filter for every creature, so the whole board gained trample with no target chosen. "that creature also gains" is now the pronoun "that creature".
